content.text:
I submitted index 1 (Sb fraction 0.143), which had the highest efficiency I measured: 0.073% EQE.

I used all 5 EQE measurements and 1 of the 5 XRD measurements:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.143 | **0.073** |
| 2 | 0.164 | 0.063 |
| 6 | 0.274 | 0.022 |
| 21 | 0.725 | 0.0015 |
| 13 | 0.493 | −0.005 |

- **Trend:** efficiency falls steadily as antimony increases. The films are essentially inactive at the 1:1 Fe:Sb composition (index 13) and in the Sb-rich range (index 21).
- **XRD at index 1:** the pattern is dominated by the rutile-type FeSbO4 peaks. I didn't see the main iron oxide (hematite) peaks, though I only compared positions by eye and didn't run a pattern match.
- **Not measured:** index 0 (Sb 0.123) is the most Fe-rich composition on the line and could be slightly better, given the trend. I used the last measurement on index 2 to check for a peak just above index 1, and there wasn't one.
- **Gaussian-process suggestion:** I didn't follow its pick of the Sb-rich end (index 28), because every Sb-rich film I measured was near zero.
